Permission scopes

Limit what this key pair can do. You can edit scopes later from Settings → API keys.

contracts:read
default

List, fetch, and download contract objects and their parsed structure trees.

default

Upload new contracts, replace versions, and update metadata such as counterparties and tags.

clauses:extract
default

Run the clause extraction model and return typed clause objects (indemnity, term, IP, etc.).

redlines:suggest
writes diffs

Generate suggested redline diffs against a saved playbook. Counts toward your monthly suggestion quota.

webhooks:manage
admin

Create, update, and delete webhook endpoints for contract.parsed and redline.ready events.

Key hygiene checklist
Store
sk_*
in a server-side secret manager — never ship to the browser.
Pair each environment (sandbox, staging, live) with its own dedicated key.
Rotate every 90 days or immediately after a teammate offboards.
Restrict scopes to the minimum your service actually needs.
